topic: Emerging trend: the smartphone screen is gradually becoming less central as the primary interface between people and digital technology. This is NOT a claim that smartphones are disappearing or being replaced outright. It is about multiple independent signals -- such as AI assistants and AI agents, smart glasses, voice interfaces and earbuds, other wearables, ambient computing, and cars or homes acting as interfaces -- that, taken together, point toward digital interaction spreading beyond the smartphone touchscreen. Aim: research several independent signals (specific products, adoption/usage data, company strategies or announcements) in different categories, each with its own source, using only facts confirmed by web search (no invented details, no facts supplied from the assistant's own prior knowledge). Do not fix the article's angle to only one of the example signals listed above; the facts collected should allow a synthesis across multiple independent signals.

kept_facts.claim: Google announced Gemini Intelligence for Android, with features to automate multi-step tasks such as booking rides or shopping, and said the features would extend beyond phones to watches, cars, glasses, and laptops later in 2026.
kept_facts.subject: Google Gemini Intelligence / Android
kept_facts.scope: Selected Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel phones first; broader Android device categories later in 2026
kept_facts.conditions: Google said initial features would roll out in waves; availability depends on device and software compatibility.
kept_facts.source_title: A smarter, more proactive Android with Gemini Intelligence
kept_facts.ambiguity: The announcement describes planned rollout timing, not completed deployment across all listed device categories.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: Treat as a company strategy and rollout announcement, not as evidence of broad user adoption. ([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-intelligence/))

kept_facts.claim: Google demonstrated Android XR glasses equipped with a camera, microphones, speakers, and an optional in-lens display; Google said the glasses could work with Gemini for messaging, appointments, turn-by-turn directions, photos, and live language translation without requiring the user to reach for a phone.
kept_facts.subject: Google Android XR glasses
kept_facts.date_or_period: May 20, 2025; product demonstration and partner development stage
kept_facts.scope: Android XR glasses prototypes and planned ecosystem products
kept_facts.conditions: Google described a sneak peek and ongoing work with partners including Samsung, Gentle Monster, Warby Parker, and Kering Eyewear; commercial availability was not established in the cited passage.
kept_facts.source_title: Google I/O 2025: Gemini on Android XR coming to glasses, headsets
kept_facts.ambiguity: The source demonstrates intended use cases and hardware characteristics but does not provide consumer adoption data.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: Treat this as a product-development and interface-direction signal, not as evidence of mass-market deployment. ([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-xr-gemini-glasses-headsets/)) UPDATE (this fix): a later Google announcement (see F008_FIX, blog.google/.../android-xr-io-2026/, 2026-05-19) confirmed a fall 2026 commercial launch for the first (audio-only) product in this Android XR eyewear ecosystem, tied to the Gentle Monster and Warby Parker collections. Do not describe the Android XR eyewear line overall as having no confirmed launch date or as still being only a development-stage demonstration; that framing is outdated for at least the audio-only product. The camera/optional-in-lens-display variant described here in F008 remains a distinct product tier without its own confirmed fall 2026 launch date -- combine both facts (F008 + F008_FIX) for the current, tier-differentiated status.
kept_facts.verification_notes: 中核の主張は独立再照合で確認できる。Googleは2025年5月20日のAndroid XRデモについて、カメラ・マイク・スピーカー、任意のインレンズディスプレイ、スマートフォンに手を伸ばさずに使えるGemini連携、メッセージ送信、予定作成、ターンバイターン案内、写真撮影、リアルタイム翻訳を記載している。第三者報道も同じ仕様・デモ内容と日付を確認している。([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-xr-gemini-glasses-headsets/)) ただし条件欄の「Gentle Monster、Warby Parker、Kering Eyewearを含むパートナーと進行中の作業」という表現には注意が必要。Googleが現時点の提携先として明示したのはGentle Monster、Warby Parker、Samsungで、Kering Eyewearは「将来さらに協力したいパートナーの例」として挙げられているにとどまる。したがって、Factの本体は支持されるが、Keringを既存の進行中パートナーと読める条件表現は曖昧。なお、消費者向け販売開始や普及を示すデータがないという留保は、Googleがプロトタイプと信頼できるテスターからのフィードバック、今後の提供時期の更新に言及しているため妥当。

kept_facts.claim: Google announced that the first commercially available product in its Android XR eyewear ecosystem -- audio-only 'intelligent eyewear' (audio glasses, without a display) -- would launch in fall 2026, as part of the Gentle Monster and Warby Parker eyewear collections. This is a distinct, narrower product tier than the camera/optional-in-lens-display Android XR glasses prototype described in F008.
kept_facts.subject: Google Android XR ecosystem: first commercial product (audio-only glasses) launch timing
kept_facts.date_or_period: Announced May 19, 2026; launch stated for fall 2026
kept_facts.scope: The audio-only ('audio glasses') tier of Google's Android XR eyewear ecosystem, positioned as the first commercially shipping product in that ecosystem; specific country/market availability at launch was not fully confirmed in the cited passage.
kept_facts.conditions: Google described this fall 2026 launch as applying specifically to audio-only glasses, not to the full camera/optional-in-lens-display Android XR glasses demoed in 2025 (F008); the source did not establish which countries/markets would have launch-day availability (a related Samsung announcement referenced 'select markets').
kept_facts.source_title: Intelligent eyewear with Gemini is coming this fall
kept_facts.ambiguity: The source confirms a fall 2026 launch tied to named eyewear-brand collections for the audio-only tier specifically; it does not confirm a fall 2026 commercial launch for the full camera/display Android XR glasses variant, nor specific country/market availability, exact release date, or adoption/sales data.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: This confirms that Google's Android XR eyewear ecosystem has moved from a pure product demonstration (2025, F008) to an actual company-announced commercial launch timeframe (fall 2026) for its first (audio-only) product. Do not describe the Android XR eyewear line overall as 'still only a development-stage demonstration with no confirmed launch' -- that framing is now outdated for at least this first product. At the same time, do not conflate this audio-only launch with a confirmed launch of the full camera/display glasses in F008, and do not conflate 'launch announced' with 'available everywhere' or 'already widely adopted'. UPDATE (galaxy xr fix): do not describe this fall 2026 audio-only launch as Google's 'first Android XR product' without qualification -- see F008_FIX2. Google's Android XR platform page describes the Samsung Galaxy XR headset (a different hardware form factor, not eyewear) as the first device on the Android XR platform overall, and it is already available. This audio-only glasses launch is the first audio-only/eyewear product within the Android XR eyewear line specifically, not the platform's first product overall.
kept_facts.verification_notes: Googleの公式発表は2026年5月19日付で、インテリジェント・アイウェアを音声型（audio glasses）と表示型（display glasses）に分け、音声型を先に2026年秋の後半に発売すると明記している。また、Gentle MonsterとWarby Parkerのフルコレクションの一部として初期デザインを発売すると説明している。([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-xr-io-2026/)) Samsungの公式発表も、Gentle MonsterおよびWarby Parkerとの最初のコレクションを2026年秋に一部市場で発売予定とし、発売市場が限定され得ることを明記している。([news.samsung.com](https://news.samsung.com/us/samsung-google-first-look-new-intelligent-eyewear/)) 音声型が表示なしである点は、独立報道が「レンズ内ディスプレイなし」と確認しており、Googleの音声型／表示型という区分とも整合する。([macrumors.com](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/05/19/google-ai-smart-glasses-iphone-support/)) よって、2026年秋という発売時期、音声型が表示型に先行すること、両ブランドのコレクションとの関係、2025年に示されたカメラ・任意表示ディスプレイのプロトタイプとは別の製品層であることは確認できる。ただし、これは発表された発売計画であり、2026年9月14日時点での実売開始、全市場での提供、採用規模や販売実績を意味しない。

kept_facts.claim: Google's Android XR platform page identifies the Samsung Galaxy XR headset as the first available device built on the Android XR platform, and describes it as already available -- distinct from the fall 2026 audio-only glasses (F008_FIX) and the camera/optional-in-lens-display glasses prototype (F008), which are a separate hardware form factor (eyewear, not a headset) without the same 'first device' status.
kept_facts.subject: Android XR platform: first available device overall (Samsung Galaxy XR headset) vs. first eyewear/audio-only product
kept_facts.date_or_period: Not stated as a specific launch date in the cited platform page; the page describes Galaxy XR as already available at the time of citation.
kept_facts.scope: Samsung Galaxy XR headset as described on Google's Android XR platform page (android.com/xr/); the cited passage does not establish specific country/market availability details.
kept_facts.conditions: The platform page's 'first device' characterization applies to the Android XR platform overall (headset form factor), not specifically to the eyewear/glasses product line described in F008/F008_FIX, which are a different hardware form factor (glasses, not a headset).
kept_facts.source_title: Learn About Extended Reality & Immersive VR with Android XR
kept_facts.ambiguity: The exact wording of 'first device' status and precise release date/region for Galaxy XR were not directly quoted in the passage available before this verification call; confirm via web_search whether android.com/xr/ (or a closely related Samsung/Google source) directly supports Galaxy XR as the first Android XR device and as already available.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: Do not describe the fall 2026 audio-only glasses (F008_FIX) as 'the first Android XR product' without qualification. Google's Android XR platform page describes the Samsung Galaxy XR headset -- a different hardware form factor (headset, not eyewear) -- as the first device on the Android XR platform overall, and it is already available. Use precise phrasing: Galaxy XR headset = first Android XR device overall (already available); fall 2026 audio-only glasses = first audio-only / eyewear product in the Android XR eyewear line (not yet launched).
kept_facts.verification_notes: GoogleのAndroid XR公式ページは、FAQで「The first device, Samsung Galaxy XR, is available now」、availability欄で「The first headset device, Samsung Galaxy XR, is available now」と明記しており、Galaxy XRをAndroid XRの最初のデバイス／最初のヘッドセットとして、すでに提供中と位置付けている。([android.com](https://www.android.com/xr/?utm_source=openai)) Google公式ブログもGalaxy XRを「the very first device built on Android XR」とし、発売当日から米国・韓国で購入可能と説明しており、source_url以外の公式情報でも主要部分が独立に裏付けられる。([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/samsung-galaxy-xr/?utm_source=openai)) また、Googleの2026年5月19日付発表は、Android XRの知的アイウェアを音声のみのaudio glassesと表示付きdisplay glassesに分け、audio glassesを先に「later this fall」に投入すると説明している。したがって、Galaxy XRの「Android XR全体で最初のデバイス／ヘッドセット」という位置付けを、後続の音声型メガネや別形態の表示付きメガネ試作機にそのまま適用しない、という条件も妥当。([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-xr-io-2026/?utm_source=openai)) Googleの別の公式説明では、試作メガネはカメラ・マイク・スピーカーを備え、オプションのインレンズディスプレイを持つ眼鏡形態として記述されており、ヘッドセットとは別のハードウェア形態である。([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/android-xr-glasses-demo-io-2025/?utm_source=openai)) なお、「fall 2026」はプラットフォームページ自体の文言ではなく、2026年5月19日付発表の「this fall」からの時間的な読み替えであり、ページ単独に厳密な発売日・地域情報を帰属させないというLedgerの条件は適切。

kept_facts.claim: Apple introduced Siri AI on Apple Watch through watchOS 27, describing personal-context understanding and broad world knowledge available from the wrist; Apple said the beta rollout began September 14, 2026, with English first and additional languages planned for October.
kept_facts.subject: Apple Watch Siri AI
kept_facts.date_or_period: Introduced September 9, 2026; beta rollout scheduled for September 14, 2026
kept_facts.scope: Supported Apple Watch devices paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled device
kept_facts.conditions: Apple stated that Siri AI requires a supported device and supported language; English was listed for the initial beta, with French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish planned for October.
kept_facts.source_title: Introducing Apple Watch Series 12, with the all-new Health Sensing System
kept_facts.ambiguity: The announcement describes product availability and planned rollout conditions, not user adoption.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: Use the exact rollout date and language/device conditions; do not describe Siri AI as universally available on all Apple Watch models. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/09/introducing-apple-watch-series-12-with-the-all-new-health-sensing-system/))
kept_facts.verification_notes: Apple公式発表は、watchOS 27でApple Watch上のSiri AIを導入し、個人コンテキスト理解と広範な世界知識を提供すると記載している。ベータ展開は2026年9月14日、英語で開始し、フランス語・日本語・韓国語・ポルトガル語・スペイン語を10月に追加予定という日付と言語条件も一致する。なお、AppleはEUでのwatchOS上の初期提供不可やApple Intelligence対応端末要件も明記しており、これらは本文の条件欄に追加可能な制約である。([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/09/introducing-apple-watch-series-12-with-the-all-new-health-sensing-system/))

kept_facts.claim: Google stated that more than 250 million cars supported Android Auto and that more than 50 car models with Google built-in were on the road; Google also announced plans to bring Gemini to Android Auto and cars with Google built-in.
kept_facts.subject: Google Android Auto and Google built-in
kept_facts.date_or_period: May 13, 2025; counts and rollout plans stated at that time
kept_facts.scope: Cars supporting Android Auto and car models with Google built-in
kept_facts.conditions: Google described Gemini availability as forthcoming and stated that supported features and countries would vary.
kept_facts.numeric_value: Over 250 million cars; more than 50 car models
kept_facts.numeric_scope: Cars supporting Android Auto; car models with Google built-in on the road
kept_facts.source_title: Driving just got more productive — and fun — with Gemini and more
kept_facts.ambiguity: The figures are company-reported; “support” does not necessarily mean active usage, and the source does not define whether the Android Auto figure is a global installed base or another measure.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: Use as a scale and distribution signal for in-car interfaces; do not equate supported cars with active users. ([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-for-cars/))
kept_facts.verification_notes: Google公式発表は、Android Autoをサポートする車が2億5,000万台超、Google built-in搭載車種が50超で道路上にあると記載している。また、GeminiをAndroid Autoには今後数か月、Google built-in搭載車には同年後半に提供する計画も明記している。車両数は利用者数ではないというLedgerの注意書きも適切。([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/platforms/android/gemini-for-cars/))

kept_facts.claim: Apple began rolling out CarPlay Ultra with Aston Martin vehicles in the United States and Canada; the system can place iPhone and vehicle information across all driver screens, including the instrument cluster, and allows vehicle controls through onscreen controls, physical buttons, or Siri.
kept_facts.subject: Apple CarPlay Ultra
kept_facts.scope: New Aston Martin vehicle orders in the United States and Canada at launch; Hyundai, Kia, and Genesis were identified as newly committed brands
kept_facts.conditions: Availability depends on vehicle model, automaker integration, and software support.
kept_facts.source_title: CarPlay Ultra, the next generation of CarPlay, begins rolling out today
kept_facts.ambiguity: The source confirms launch and automaker commitments but does not provide deployment volume or user adoption data.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: The fact supports a shift of digital interaction into the vehicle’s native displays and controls; it does not indicate that the iPhone itself is no longer involved. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/05/carplay-ultra-the-next-generation-of-carplay-begins-rolling-out-today/))
kept_facts.verification_notes: Apple公式発表は、2025年5月15日に米国・カナダの新しいAston Martin車両注文からCarPlay Ultraの展開を開始したこと、計器クラスターを含む全ドライバーディスプレイへの情報表示、画面・物理ボタン・Siriによる車両操作を記載している。Hyundai、Kia、Genesisの新規コミットメントも確認できる。別途、iPhone 12以降かつiOS 18.5以降が必要という条件があるため、条件欄には追加余地がある。([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/05/carplay-ultra-the-next-generation-of-carplay-begins-rolling-out-today/))

kept_facts.claim: Google launched Gemini for Home to replace Google Assistant on smart displays and speakers and to enhance cameras, doorbells, and the Google Home app with natural-language conversation, camera summaries, video-history search, device control, and automation creation.
kept_facts.subject: Google Gemini for Home
kept_facts.date_or_period: October 1, 2025; early-access rollout began in October 2025
kept_facts.scope: Google speakers, smart displays, cameras, doorbells, and the Google Home app
kept_facts.conditions: Google said the update would come to every speaker, smart display, camera, and doorbell made during the previous decade; advanced features such as Gemini Live, AI-powered notifications, video-history search, and Ask Home automations require Google Home Premium.
kept_facts.numeric_value: Devices made during the previous decade
kept_facts.numeric_scope: Google Home and Nest device generations targeted for the rollout
kept_facts.source_title: Gemini for Home: The helpful home gets an AI upgrade
kept_facts.ambiguity: The rollout was described as early access, and the source does not provide the installed base or adoption rate of compatible devices.
kept_facts.notes_for_writer: Use as evidence of the home itself becoming an interaction surface; distinguish included assistant upgrades from subscription-gated advanced features. ([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/devices/google-nest/gemini-for-home-launch/))
kept_facts.verification_notes: Google公式発表は、Gemini for Homeがスマートディスプレイとスピーカー上のGoogle Assistantを置き換え、カメラ、ドアベル、Google Homeアプリも強化すると直接説明している。自然言語による会話、カメラ通知・要約、動画履歴検索、デバイス制御、自動化作成も記載されている。過去10年間に製造された対象機器への早期アクセス展開と、Gemini Live・AI通知・動画履歴検索・Ask Home等のGoogle Home Premium要件も確認できる。([blog.google](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/devices/google-nest/gemini-for-home-launch/))

note: CONFIRMED(VERIFIED)のみ採用。AMBIGUOUS/REJECTEDはfact_ledger_verification.jsonに記録済みだが本Ledgerからは除外した。

fix_applied.reason: Fact Checker FAIL(run1)で判明した、Google Android XR/Geminiスマートグラスの2026年秋発売公式発表(Research時点で既に存在した事実)の取りこぼしを修正。
Fact Checker FAIL(run2)で判明した、記事が「Googleの最初のAndroid XR製品は2026年秋のaudio-onlyグラス」と記述し、実際はSamsung Galaxy XRヘッドセットが既にAndroid XRプラットフォームの最初のデバイスとして提供中である点と矛盾していた誤りを修正。
